description:
Rewrite every unqualified `cites:<key>` label to the qualified form `cites:@/citation/<key>`, which the installed JIT resolves through the citation registry.

## Background

The installed JIT no longer resolves unqualified link labels. Every `cites:<key>` label (177 at filing) is reported by `jit validate` as a dangling-item-link error, so `repo-validate` fails repository-wide.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every `cites:` label names its citation as `cites:@/citation/<key>`, and each key resolves through `jit item show`; a label whose key is absent from `.jit/references.toml` is listed in the commit message with its issue and handled without inventing a registry entry.
- [hard] REQ-02: `jit validate` reports no dangling-item-link error for a `cites:` label.
- [hard] REQ-03: Configuration examples, planning tooling and manifests in this repository that emit or document `cites:` labels use only the qualified form.
title: Migrate cites labels to the qualified citation form
